_about: Rule Change Log — §6. Append only. Never delete an entry, even after it is superseded: a report for a past month must be able to resolve what applied then.
_how: Each entry says what changed, for whom, and from what date. Entries with a 'pay_basis' override the basis §1.2 would have inferred from the filled columns — the inference is a convenience, this is the decision.

entries.detail: Roster, salaries and thresholds as of the FY2025-26 Staff Master snapshot. Everything before this date is out of scope for the engine.

Threshold hours 280 -> 270 and threshold days 28 -> 27, together. 270 hours at a ten-hour day is 27 days; moving one without the other understated FY2025-26 payroll by 8,006.15 against the reported total.

Both Monthly Salary and Threshold Hour are filled for this person, so §1.2 would infer Attendance-based. That inference is wrong here — the arrangement is flat pay, unchanged by attendance in either direction. This entry is what makes the pay correct; without it the inference would silently take over.

entries.what: Contract basis for the iron job
entries.detail: Moved from 100 per hour to a per-piece contract rate. The per-piece figure has not been supplied, so these months resolve as Unresolvable rather than zero — deliberately visible until the rate is filled in.
